C1300.title: GitHub Actions Exploited to Leak Tokens from 14 Popular Open-Source Projects
C1300.summary: In August 2024, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 disclosed the ArtiPACKED GitHub Actions attack vector, involving token exposure risks in open-source projects from companies such as Google, Microsoft, AWS, and Red Hat. These tokens could be used to access code repositories, inject malicious code, or further access cloud resources, increasing supply-chain security risk.
